verdict.rationale: Cognee documents a multi-user permissions system with dataset-scoped permissions and per-dataset storage, so multiple users or organizations can share one instance while keeping their data completely separate. Sessions are keyed by (user_id, session_id), and the founder describes per-user graphs combined with user permissions and graph filtering. missing for 10: explicit per-agent scoping (only implied via datasets/sessions), detailed docs on how recall enforces scope at query time, independent or hands-on corroboration that no cross-tenant leakage occurs.
